market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: In a 10-team IPL, even the weakest team has a base probability well above 1.1%, and KKR is a strong franchise, winner in 2024. The current price is an extreme outlier, likely due to thin trading, and true odds are closer to 10%, yielding a massive edge.
evidence_points: 10-team league implies average championship probability of 10% per team.
KKR won the 2024 IPL and consistently fields competitive squads.
Historical betting odds for weaker teams rarely go below 3-5% implied chance.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL structure and KKR performance
